FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.label: Orbital Fuel Depot
FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.desc: Stores and processes fuel for spacecraft. Essential for maintaining orbital operations and supporting space travel. +0.5 power production, +0.3 chemfuel production. $400 upkeep cost.

FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.label: Asteroid Mining Platform
FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.desc: Automated mining drones harvest resources from nearby asteroids and space debris. Much more efficient than planetary mining. +0.8 base mining production. $400 upkeep cost.

FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.label: Solar Collection Array
FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.desc: Massive solar panel arrays with no atmospheric interference collect energy directly from the star. Powers the station and provides surplus energy. +2.0 base power production. $650 upkeep cost.
